# Commit 1: utilcode cleanup
git add lib/utilcode/
git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
utilcode: consolidate stream-close boilerplate via CloseUtils

Wire the previously-unused CloseUtils into UtilsBridge (closeIO /
closeIOQuietly) and replace ~29 hand-rolled quiet-close finally blocks
across the utilcode module with calls to it (net -163 lines).

Also moves three inline closes (SpanUtils, ProcessUtils, DeviceUtils)
into finally blocks, fixing latent leaks on the exception path, and
drops two now-unused IOException imports.

ZipUtils is intentionally left untouched: its finally blocks propagate
close() IOExceptions by contract (the methods declare throws IOException).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

# Commit 2: subutil try-with-resources refactor
git add lib/subutil/src/main/java/com/blankj/subutil/util/http/HttpUtils.java \
        lib/subutil/src/main/java/com/blankj/subutil/util/HttpsUtil.java
git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
subutil: use try-with-resources for stream handling

Refactor HttpUtils and HttpsUtil to manage streams with
try-with-resources instead of hand-rolled finally/close blocks
(net -36 lines). Deliberately keeps the module's intentional lack of a
utilcode dependency: plain Java, no CloseUtils.

Also fixes a Scanner leak in HttpsUtil and a leaked InputStream on the
exception path in HttpUtils.Call.run. Note: close/flush failures on
write paths are now reported (return false/"") rather than swallowed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

# Commit 3: bug fixes + dead code
git add -A
git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
fix(subutil): correct temperature conversions, PendingIntent flag, and remove dead code

Correctness fixes:
- TemperatureUtils.fToK/kToF were missing the scale factor (offset-only
  result). Reimplement by composing the correct converters, e.g.
  fToK = cToK(fToC(t)).
- DangerousUtils.sendSmsSilent passed flags=0 to PendingIntent.getBroadcast,
  which throws IllegalArgumentException on Android 12 (API 31)+. Add
  FLAG_IMMUTABLE on API 31+ (literal, since this module compiles vs SDK 29).

Dead-code removal (all verified unreferenced):
- Delete commented-out GlideUtils and empty RetrofitUtils.
- Delete unused http interceptor stubs: Chain, Interceptor, Headers.
- Delete empty, unreferenced utildebug TextViewer.
- Remove the commented-out getLocation block in LocationUtils.
- Remove the main() demo harness (and now-unused Log import) from BitUtils.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
